Design, deploy, and operate LLM inference services on the Model-as-a-Service (MaaS) marketplace, serving open-source foundation models (Llama 4, Qwen3, DeepSeek V3/R1) and multi-modal workloads (text generation, TTS, STT, vision, embeddings) at production scale across Vietnam and Japan regions.

Tune and optimize inference engines (vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, SGLang, NVIDIA Dynamo, LMCache) using continuous batching, PagedAttention, Prefix Caching, Chunked Prefill, Speculative Decoding, and FlashAttention, FlashInfer to reduce TTFT, increase throughput, and lower cost-per-token.

Operate distributed inference at scale: Tensor / Pipeline / Expert Parallelism (for MoE models like DeepSeek V3, Qwen3-MoE), disaggregated prefill/decode workers, KV cache sizing and CPU/disk offload across H100 / H200 / B300 GPU fleets; apply FP8, FP4 quantization with measured accuracy/latency trade-offs.

Run Kubernetes + GPU infrastructure with GitOps (ArgoCD, Helmfile): GPU operator, KEDA and custom HPA on token throughput, multi-tenant GPU sharing (MIG), canary and A/B rollouts for new model versions, and chaos testing (GPU failure injection, OOM scenarios).

Build LLM-specific observability and SLOs: GPU metrics (NVIDIA DCGM), inference metrics (TTFT, ITL, tokens/sec, KV cache hit rate, queue time), per-token billing accuracy, response quality monitoring, plus security and safety controls (prompt injection defense, prompt/KV cache isolation between tenants, content moderation, PII redaction, audit logging for cross-border compliance including Japan APPI). Production experience deploying LLMs ≥ 7B parameters with verifiable metrics — QPS, P95 TTFT/ITL, and cost per 1M tokens — not just calling pre-built APIs.
Hands-on tuning expertise in vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or SGLang beyond default configuration; deep understanding of continuous batching, PagedAttention, prefix caching, and KV cache management.
Strong Kubernetes skills with production GPU scheduling experience: GPU operator, KEDA, custom HPA, node feature discovery, MIG, and multi-tenant GPU isolation.
